pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: On-board 3.3 V regulator: 3V3 or 5 V both work on most boards

pins.name: LED
pins.notes: Backlight: to 3V3 (always on) or through a transistor for dimming

pins.name: SDO(MISO)
pins.notes: Leave unconnected if touch or SD misbehave: some ILI9488 boards never release this line

pins.name: T_CLK
pins.notes: Touch controller clock (XPT2046), shares the SPI bus

pins.name: T_IRQ
pins.notes: LOW while the screen is touched
